result:
If I had one lever, I’d make it impossible to fully dehumanize another person.

You could still disagree, fear, compete, even hate. But you could never genuinely file someone into the category of “not really human,” “not really suffering,” “not really real.” That lie is the load-bearing wall under so much cruelty—war, slavery, caste, pogroms, neglect. Remove it, and the world doesn’t become kind automatically. It just becomes much harder to be monstrous at a distance.
